system.description: You slam your weapon down into your opponent and quickly follow up with a flurry of strikes. Each swing creates a spectral visage of your weapon that passes through all enemies in front of you. Make 7 melee taijutsu attacks vs the AC of all targets in this jutsu's range. On hit, targets take your weapons damage die+2d8. A target that is hit by all 7 attacks is knocked Prone and has their movement speed reduced to 0 until the end of their next turn. These attacks cannot score a critical hit.
